edits.diagnosis: “A certain number” leaves unclear that the warmup option specifies the number of executions.
edits.quote: perform a certain number of program executions
edits.reader_benefit: Clarifies what the warmup option controls before the reader reaches the example.
edits.replacement: perform the specified number of program executions
edits.retained_meaning: The program executes a chosen number of times before the benchmark.

folder includes a lot

visualizations

folder includes Python programs to analyze benchmark results and create
visualizations
